model.note: Part outlines are traced from Turfco's photo of the engine-powered WideSpin 1550 (loaded with sand) and are approximate. The conveyor, hydraulic system, display box and engine air cleaner are not visible and are in the parts list. Part numbers come from operator's manual 669320 (tow-vehicle hydraulic models 85824/85825); the engine-powered model's own manual (hydraulic oil and filter) was not found: confirm the product number on the ID plate.

hopper.name: Hopper
hopper.desc: Stainless hopper over the conveyor belt. Before use make sure nothing is left in it (tools, rocks). After use clean out topdressing build-up from the hopper and both sides of the belt: low-pressure wash only, no high-pressure wash (it damages the belt and the display box).

conveyor.name: Conveyor belt, rollers and bearings
conveyor.desc: Belt 663998 (18 in pebble-top, directional: fit per manual p.41 with the outside edges aligned at the splice), splice 655363. Driven by a hydraulic motor (669022), not chains (the old Notion chain rows are wrong). Tension: start at 19 mm (3/4 in) at the adjuster-screw ends; if it slips under load tighten both screws equally, 1/4 turn at a time. Tracking: fix unequal tension first, make small adjustments, both ends of the rear roller should be visible; the belt must not rub the hopper seals or frame. Check tension and tracking often during work. Rollers: idler (extruded) 668039, drive 661433, on 4 sealed pillow-block bearings 665429 (1.25 in bore; a 1-1/4 in 2-bolt pillow block is UCP206-20 or UCP207-20 depending on housing size: measure the bolt centres). Yearly: inspect belt, splice, scraper, pan and plastic pan cover, rollers and bearings. Storage: release the belt tension and keep out of direct sun; re-tension to 19 mm on return.

body.name: Side panels
body.desc: WideSpin 1550 body panels. Low-pressure wash only and keep water off the display box. Before use check for loose fasteners and damaged parts and fix them first.

engcover.name: Engine cover
engcover.desc: The engine cover latch has broken before on this unit: check it is secure every use, and check the latch and hinge at the annual service.

hood.name: Rear guard and deflector
hood.desc: Guards on the 1550 and the spinner assembly must be present and undamaged: do not run without them. Clean topdressing build-up off the rear deflector after use; build-up causes vibration and a poor spread.

spinner.name: Spinner assembly
spinner.desc: Two spinners on hydraulic motors 669276 (seal kit 669468). Vanes 669024 LH and 669025 RH, 3 of each (vanes, not brushes: the old Notion brush row is wrong). Spinner flange bearings (i-glide) 661400, 2 per spinner assembly. Daily: spinner wheel alignment, damage, wear and missing hardware; vanes tight; clean build-up off the spinners and under the spinner wheels. Yearly: inspect the vanes and the spinner motor seals. Storage: a film of light oil on the spinner wheels.

frame.name: Chassis
frame.desc: Tow-behind chassis: no PTO and no 3-point linkage (the old Notion PTO, shear bolt, gearbox and linkage-pin rows are wrong). Before use tighten loose fasteners and fix damaged parts.

tyre.name: Tyres
tyre.desc: 26.5 x 14.00-12 4-ply turf tyres at 138 kPa (20 psi): check before use. No Turfco part number listed (size from the Turfco spec page). The old Notion size 18.5 x 8.50-8 is wrong.

engine.name: Engine: Briggs & Stratton Vanguard 14 hp
engine.desc: Vanguard 400 (408 cc), 14 hp, driving the on-board hydraulic system. Top Dresser 1 is taken to be the engine-powered model (85831 standard or 85836 Smart Control) from its hour meter (about 108 h) and engine cover: confirm the product number on the ID plate. Daily: oil level, air cleaner, fuel. Oil 0.94 L (25V3 / 25E3); oil spec per the Vanguard manual (typically SAE 30 or 10W-30 small-engine oil, confirm). Change every 50 h or yearly: a conservative placeholder until the Vanguard manual for the model-type-code on the shroud is checked. Spark plug and fuel system per the Vanguard manual.

aircleaner.name: Engine air cleaner
aircleaner.desc: Vanguard cyclonic cartridge rated to 600 h: 84002310 (Vanguard 400 series 14 hp; fit list 25E330, 25E337, 25V332, 25V336, 25V337: check the engine model-type-code before ordering). UK listing GBP 21.28 (Mitchells); no AU price or aftermarket cross-reference found.

hydraulics.name: Hydraulic reservoir and hoses
hydraulics.desc: Check the reservoir level daily and look for leaks (never use your hands to find leaks). Yearly: hoses, fittings and oil condition. Hydraulic oil spec, capacity and filter for the engine-powered model are not in the public manual (only the tow-vehicle hydraulic 85824/85825 manual is public): get the 85831/85836 manual from Turfco or the dealer.

controls.name: Display box and controls
controls.desc: All controls must work before use. After use switch the display box OFF and unplug the power lead. Keep water off the display box.

tilt.name: Spinner tilt and swivel points
tilt.desc: Clean, inspect and lightly coat with machine oil for rust and moisture protection. No interval in the manual: monthly in season is a suggestion. The 1550's bearings are sealed: no greasing needed.

hub.name: Wheel hub and bearings
hub.desc: Service and grease the wheel bearings once a year (more often if dusty) with general-purpose bearing grease; inspect the wheel seals.
